title: Women As Sex Vendors Or, Why Women Are Conservative (Being a View of the Economic Status of Woman)

The authors argue that women’s inherent economic value as bearers of a sought-after commodity results in a societal structure that hinders their revolutionary potential, reinforcing conservative attitudes among women.
